about_lupai_description: Lupai was born out of the concrete needs of migrants facing the difficulties of bureaucracy in Germany. As there is no single, reliable source of information in our language, we decided to create an application that could meet these needs and help the whole community.
agree_data_processing: I read and agree with the data processing policy

answer_doubts_description: A multilingual chatbot will answer your questions in simple language and provide you with the original sources for a more comprehensive and thorough understanding.
aureka_description: aureka is a a software development startup focused on AI solutions for culture, academia, media and civil society. Its mission is to contribute to a broad access to information and shape AI for social good.
center_for_popular_education: Center for Popular Education Lohana Berkins
center_for_popular_education_description: The Center for Popular Education Lohana Berkins is an initiative of migrants in Berlin that seeks to create a space for the development of tools with which migrants can actively participate in the political life of German society. It offers various educational formats based on the pedagogical approach of the Latin American 'educación popular'.
confirm_new_search: Are you sure you want to start a new search?
connect_with_institutions_description: You are not alone! Lupai links you with trusted professionals and initiatives that can provide helpful and precise information according to your case.
data_privacy_description: Lupai only stores data that is essential to provide you with a response and run basic statistics. It does not store any personal data beyond the input you enter in the search field and it only shares it with third party services for the purpose of processing your query to provide a response. You can read our full Data Privacy Policy here.
edit_question: Not satisfied with the answer? Try to edit your question
example_questions: Try questions like “How do I validate my university degree in Germany?” or “How do I apply for a Rote Karte?”

fill_the_form: Kindly fill out the form, and we'll respond promptly.

legal_consultation_disclaimer: Lupai does not replace a legal consultation. Lupai conducts an AI-power search within a database of public and expert-curated documents and formulates a response to help you be informed and answer your questions. In case you have specific doubts that Lupai cannot answer, please consult with a lawyer.
lohana_berkins_description: The Educational Centre Lohana Berkins is an initiative of migrants in Berlin that seeks to create a space for the development of tools with which migrants can actively participate in the political life of German society. It offers various educational formats based on the pedagogical approach of the Latin American "educación popular".
lupai_app_description: Lupai is an AI-based web application that enables people to independently obtain information about the legal framework and administrative processes in the fields of migration and work, and to connect with relevant experts, organisations and initiatives. It also helps advice centres to work more efficiently, reach more people and provide better services.
